memoryEvidence.description: Conservative server admission policy: 128 MiB runtime budget plus the declared 32 MiB flash/RAM reserves and separately counted staging. BASE prerequisites must already be installed at their exact signed native identities; they are never installed or upgraded by this operation. These are admission settings, not measurements or a minimum-device-RAM claim.
